name: Fava
blurb: This app lets you use the Fava and Beancount double-entry bookkeeping software packages with the convenience of a desktop application.
description:
This app lets you use the Fava and Beancount double-entry bookkeeping software packages
with the convenience of a desktop application.

• Streamlined user interface — fava and beancount help you manage your finances with ease and clarity.

• Simple installation via flatpak — no need to manually configure dependencies.

• Seamless integration with your desktop environment — launch Fava and Beancount just like any other application in your GNOME desktop environment.

• Provides the fava, beancount and smart_importer software packages.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
